tests/Cluckwork.AppHost.Tests/AppHostCon.name: Local setup settings tests
tests/Cluckwork.AppHost.Tests/AppHostCon.description: Checks that the saved settings for the local development setup stay valid.

tests/Cluckwork.AppHost.Tests/AppHostMod.name: Local setup layout tests
tests/Cluckwork.AppHost.Tests/AppHostMod.description: Checks that the local development setup starts the right parts of the app and wires them together.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Accoun.name: Farm settings read tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Accoun.description: Checks that reading a farm's settings copies every field to the right place, so no two values get swapped.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Accoun.name: Connected apps switch tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Accoun.description: Checks that a request leaving out the connected-apps switch does not turn connected apps off.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Accoun.name: Farm settings rule tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Accoun.description: Checks the rules that reject bad values when someone saves a farm's settings.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Access ownership tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that the rule about who owns access to the code is claimed by exactly one part of the app.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Outside-connection reach check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Runs the outside-connection reach rules against the real code and fails if any part reaches further than allowed.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Outside-connection reach scanner
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Scans the code to find which parts reach other parts through the outside-facing connections.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Outside-connection reach tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks on small sample code that the reach scanner catches parts reaching where they should not.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Tool tier check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Runs the tool-tier rules against the real code and fails if any tool is declared at the wrong level.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Tool tier scanner
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Scans the code for the assistant-facing tools and the places they are declared and called.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Tool tier tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks on small sample code that the tool-tier scanner flags undeclared or misplaced tools.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Compatibility exception check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Runs the compatibility-exception rules against the real code and fails if an unlisted exception appears.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Compatibility exception scanner
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Scans the code for places that read another module's records directly, outside the allowed list.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Compatibility exception tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks on small sample code that the scanner finds direct reads of another module's records.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Contract sample types
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Holds small sample types used to test how a module's public contract is worked out.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module contract tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that a module's public contract is worked out correctly from its code.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module coupling table
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Builds a table of which parts of the app depend on which others.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module coupling check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks the real app's module dependencies against the allowed table and fails on new ones.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module coupling tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks on small samples that the coupling table records who reads and who writes.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Export snapshot tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that a data export reads from one consistent snapshot of the database.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: File size limit check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Fails when a source file grows past its line limit, with older oversize files held to their own caps.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Insights read-only check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that the insights part only reads records and never changes them.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module contract check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that the types each module offers to others contain no database or core record types.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module boundary analyzer tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that the build-time boundary checker flags code crossing module lines in a small two-project sample.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module ledger rules
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Defines the written record of which module owns what and which connections between modules are allowed.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module ledger check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Compares the real code with the module ledger and fails if they disagree.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module ledger scanner
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Scans the code for connections between modules and compares them with the ledger.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module ledger tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks on small samples that the ledger scanner catches disallowed or out-of-date entries.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Folder naming check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that each file's code grouping name matches the folder it sits in.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Owner grace period check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that only the owner's two-step sign-in gate can start the grace period.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module peer access check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that modules reach each other only through the offered contract.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module peer access tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks on a temporary sample that modules reaching each other without a contract are caught.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Ledger: outside connections
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Lists the outside-facing connections each module is allowed in the real ledger.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Real module ledger
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Holds the one module ledger of the real app that all the structure checks read.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Ledger: exemptions
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Holds the ledger's list of exempted items, which is empty for now.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Ledger: record ownership
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Lists which module owns each kind of stored record in the real ledger.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module seam check
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks that the seams between modules expose no database types or core records.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module seam scanner
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Scans the seams between modules for database types or core records leaking out.

tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.name: Module seam tests
tests/Cluckwork.Application.Tests/Archit.description: Checks on small samples that the seam scanner catches leaked database and record types.
